faqs.question: How do I exhibit my art?
faqs.answer:
First decide whether your work fits the Artist (wall pieces) or Vendor (table) category. Then submit the application.

There's no cost to apply. We just need basic info and a link where we can see examples of your work — site, Instagram, TikTok, Google Drive, whatever you've got.

No link? Email photos to info@pancakesandbooze.com.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Artist and Vendor?
faqs.answer:
Two ways to participate:

  • Artists: wall-hung pieces (canvases, prints, photography).
  • Vendors: goods that need a table (jewelry, clothing, sculpture).

Not allowed: selling prints from tables if they exceed 8×11 in. Anything bigger goes on the wall (as an artist) or in a small box on the floor under your work.

Got both kinds of work? Submit both applications — each has its own fee and load-in schedule.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to exhibit as an artist?
faqs.answer:
One flat hanging fee per piece, paid at registration. Pricing varies by city — see the full price chart.

WE TAKE NO COMMISSION. Once you've covered your hanging fees, you keep 100% of every sale.

faqs.question: When's the application deadline?
faqs.answer:
No fixed deadline. We accept applications until the room fills. The earlier you lock your space, the better.

The application only needs basic info and prior examples of your work. You can decide which pieces to bring later, when you're ready to pay the hanging fees.

faqs.question: How many pieces can I hang?
How much wall space do I get?
faqs.answer:
Your work hangs salon-style on 8×4 ft panels built for the show. Salon-style means we use every inch of wall from floor to ceiling. Check our Instagram Reels to see the install.

Space depends on the size of your pieces and how many you hang. In some cases you'll share the wall with another artist.

faqs.question: What are the size restrictions?
faqs.answer:
Each piece must not exceed 36×36 in (3×3 ft).

Wall panels are 8×4 ft. To leave room for title cards, lighting, and cabling, the max size the wall can fit is 36×36 in.

faqs.question: Can I sell prints and small items?
faqs.answer: Yes — place prints, stickers, pins, and small items in bins on the floor beneath your displayed work. No tables in the gallery area though — those are reserved for vendors.

faqs.question: When do I set up and take down?
faqs.answer: Installation is typically day-of between 1–5 PM. Artwork must be removed immediately after the show ends — no exceptions. Exact times come in your pre-event email.

faqs.question: Is lighting and hanging gear provided?
faqs.answer: Yes to both. Gallery walls and lighting are provided, along with hanging tools (screws, screw guns). Wire your pieces if you can, but stretched canvas works without it. No hammers or nails allowed.

faqs.question: Do exhibiting artists get free entry?
faqs.answer: Yes — you're on the guest list. Everyone else (including assistants) pays the cover. We offer discounted pre-sale tickets up to a week before, so tell your crew to grab those.

faqs.question: How do I apply as a vendor?
faqs.answer:
If you sell goods from a table (jewelry, clothing, sculpture, candles, etc.), submit the application and select "Vendor."

No cost to apply. Just basic info and a link to what you plan to sell.

If you're hanging on the wall (canvases, photography, prints), this isn't for you — check the Artists tab.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to vendor?
faqs.answer:
Vendor fees vary by city — typically $75–$150. See the full price chart for your market.

Submit your application and we'll send the full info.

faqs.question: How do I pay to reserve my space?
faqs.answer:
Once accepted, we send you a payment link. Payment is due as soon as the link arrives — wait too long and you risk losing your spot.

Vendor spots are limited and in demand, so WE DO NOT HOLD SPACES until payment is received.

faqs.question: Are tables and lighting provided?
faqs.answer:
Bring your own table and chairs. We provide the floor space.

Ambient light is on at the venue, but bring your own lighting and extension cords.

faqs.question: How big is my space?
faqs.answer: Each Vendor space fits ONE 6 ft table. Allotted space is roughly 8×5 ft.

faqs.question: What's allowed and what isn't?
faqs.answer:
Allowed: art, sculpture, crafts, jewelry, clothing, candles, accessories, small prints.

Not allowed: beverages, cigarettes, cannabis products, smoking accessories, food that requires on-site cooking, weapons, or non-art products / advertising.

Prints, photos, or original paintings are only allowed at vendor tables if they're under 8×11 in each.

faqs.question: When's the deadline?
faqs.answer:
No fixed deadline. We accept applications until vendor spots are gone.

Vendor spots fill fast — they're limited and in demand. Sooner is better.

faqs.question: When do I show up to set up my table?
faqs.answer:
Once accepted and paid, you'll get the load-in schedule. Setup is usually 2 hours before the show starts, but we'll confirm closer to the date.

Spaces are first-come, first-served. Be on time.
